description:
Resource Person: Rtn. Dr. N. Bartake
Venue: Gundecha Education Academy, Borivli
Igniting Young Minds for a Tobacco-Free Future was addressed in its entirety by Dr. Rohan N. Bartake, who highlighted the harmful impact of tobacco on health, families, communities, medical costs and the environment.
The ill effects of tobacco consumption were clearly brought forth during the course of his presentation, which gradually moved towards the positive aspects of leading a tobacco-free life.
The apt and sensible questions asked by the young learners of Grades 6 to 10 during the final lap of the session were a clear indication of their attentive listening and grasping skills. Each question was handled thoughtfully by the resource person, making the session engaging, informative and impactful.
Our health is our responsibility. Let’s not outsource it, waiting for the government or any other agency to work towards it. A confident and mature personality knows when and where to say NO.
